title: Oxva Slim Stick Blueberry Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: These Blueberry Prefilled Pods for the Oxva Slim Stick Prefilled Pod Kit deliver a sweet berry flavour in a simple, maintenance-free format. Each pod is prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, producing a smooth inhale and up to 600 puffs depending on your style of vaping. The flavour recreates the rich, ripe taste of Blueberries with a sweetness that sits comfortably without being overpowering. A gentle note of tartness rounds out the profile, giving this pod a more authentic fruit character. Thanks to the built-in coil, each pod delivers consistent vapour and flavour until it’s time for a replacement. Supplied in a pack of two, these Blueberry pods offer an easy, flavourful option for Slim Stick users who enjoy berry-inspired vapes.
